    I split this off from clickbait bandits for discoverability, and because it has grown larger than its source notebook. Figure 1 Since the advent of the LLM era, the term human reward hacking has become salient. This is because we fine tune lots of LLMs using reinforcement learning, and RL algorithms are notoriously prone to “cheating” in a manner we interpret as “reward hacking”. Things I have been reading on this theme: Benton et al. (2024), Greenblatt et al. (2024), Laine et al. (2024), Saunders et al. (2022), Sharma et al. (2025),Wen et al. (2024).
